text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, at a certain concert venue...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I know you're just a guest performer
today, but
it's still your first concert. Do
you feel all right?
Would you like some
water?

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Don't you worry about me! I'll
make sure to
show everyone a great
time!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... You look ready to take on the
world!
Okay, go get 'em!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, the opening act's just some
no-name artist.
Guess I'll go buy a drink.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(Do your best... All I can do now is watch
over
you...)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
King! You came to listen to her perform?
I'm so
glad to see you like her! ♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
P-Pearl?! I-I wouldn't go so far as to say
that I like
her or anything...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I was curious to know what she's like
since I kept
hearing her song every day
in the academy
announcements...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
After all, a first-rate Umamusume like
me must
familiarize herself with all kinds
of music!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
Hello! Not many of you are listening, but
I'm still
going to sing with my whole
heart... so I can
inspire you all to stay
positive, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Don't worry, King. You'll learn
aaall about
what she's like.

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what's going on? Is that a concert

happening? Huh? Who's that singing?

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text: FIGHT OOOON!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, she's really good! Listening to
her's getting
me all fired up! She's the
best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"However tough the times, don't give
up"—her
message lights a blazing fire in
the listeners'
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So what did you think? Doesn't her
sound touch
your soul?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well... I want to say it was too noisy,
but... I
suppose that's just your type of
music, Pearl.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Still... what a song. It felt like my heart
was being
assaulted by a battering ram.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I do love her music! But that's not
all.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I want her to be rewarded for all the
struggle and
hard work she's gone
through singing to people
who pass her
by on the street.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: But... that's just—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Wishful thinking? I know. I know there
are many
things that don't come true no
matter how hard
someone tries. That's
simply reality.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I support her exactly because I know
how noble,
yet futile, hard work can be!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You understand it too, don't you? How
much the
power of even a single voice
can support
someone?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The moment someone is ready to give
up, that's
when you yell the loudest.
When they're about to
lose faith, you
give them that push.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So I'm going to cheer that girl on, with
all my
might, until broken dreams
become a thing of the
past!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Supporters and the supported stand on
opposite
sides of the same coin. Or
rather, they're what
each other sees
when looking into the mirror.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Heh. No wonder...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's why it felt like she was singing
about me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I pass by the front of the
station...

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
Pearl, I wanna write a song based off
you! I'm sure
it'll inspire others chasing
after their own dreams!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That sounds fantastic! You're going to
make me
an Umamusume who changes
the world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's aim for the stars and make a song
that'll fill
the world with courage!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have a strong feeling that as long as
those two
work together, they'll be able
to make that dream
come true!
